note: فکر means thought/concern/worry/anxiety. 'Concern' alone is too narrow.
حیات is a noun meaning life/lifetime/existence. 'Alive' is not the normal direct POS/meaning of حیات and adjective POS is misleading.
جیسا is a resemblance/comparative form meaning like/as/such as. 'Closed-class' is too vague.
The same written form is also an established English loan for base in modern Urdu; omitting it conflicts with the workbook's form-based homograph treatment.
proposed_english: twenty; base (English loan, especially technical/military compounds, context-dependent)

note: Common law/code/regulation senses omitted.
عدم centrally means absence/lack/nonexistence/negation. 'Being lost' is not a suitable core learner gloss.
مال centrally means goods/property/wealth/money/assets. 'Hero; boxer' is erroneous source contamination.
مجھ is the oblique first-person pronoun and should directly tell learners 'me' rather than only give a grammatical reference.
دعا means prayer/supplication/wish/blessing and can also be a personal name. 'The prayers in the Qur'an' is overly specific as a definition.
proposed_english: prayer; supplication; wish; blessing; Dua (name, context-dependent)

note: گل in Urdu/Persian-derived vocabulary centrally means flower/rose and is also a common name element. The source's 'bole; hook; neck' is unrelated/noisy.
گیس centrally means gas and can denote gasoline in some regional/loan contexts. 'Fart' is a colloquial bodily-gas use and should not lead the general learner entry.
proposed_english: gas; gaseous fuel; gasoline/petrol (regional/context-dependent); bodily gas (colloquial)

note: اتفاق very commonly means agreement/accord as well as coincidence/chance/unity. 'Agreement' is missing.
ادبی centrally means literary/related to literature and can extend to cultured/polite contexts. 'Moral' is not a direct standard meaning.
ذہنی centrally means mental/intellectual/psychological. 'Ideal; subjective' are context-specific philosophical senses and should not lead the entry.
مسئلے is an inflected form of مسئلہ and must explicitly give problem(s)/issue(s), not only inflection labels.
جمہوریت means democracy. 'Republic' is جمہوریہ and should not be given as the direct meaning of جمہوریت.
ذاتی centrally means personal/private/individual/one's own. The source instead lists innate/natural/inherent and omits the dominant modern meaning.
proposed_english: personal; private; individual; one's own; inherent (context-dependent)

note: خوراک centrally means food/diet/nourishment and also dose. The source omits 'food' entirely.
خاتون means lady/woman and can be an honorific. 'Noblewoman' is too narrow.
خراب means bad/spoiled/broken/out of order/poor. 'Volatile' is not a standard core meaning.
proposed_english: bad; spoiled; broken; out of order; poor; ruined

note: نور centrally means light/radiance, often divine/spiritual light. The source omits plain 'light' and treats a surah reference like a lexical meaning.
proposed_english: light; radiance; divine/spiritual light; Noor (name, context-dependent)

note: حضور is an honorific/address meaning sir/your presence/His or Her Excellency and literally presence. 'Beloved' is not a core direct meaning.
proposed_english: presence; sir; respected/honored person; honorific form of address

note: تسلیم means acceptance/acknowledgment/admission/recognition and can also mean surrender/submission. 'Acceptance' alone is too narrow.
